pin_bore.rationale: Table 6: piston pin bore midpoint 1.1246-1.1250 in

pin_length.rationale: Table 6: assembly including permanent plugs, midpoint 5.2050-5.2200 in

piston_land.rationale: Table 6: below first groove midpoint 5.2140-5.2160 in

rod_side_clearance.rationale: B-2 PDF93: rod on crankpin side clearance .006-.010 in; midpoint .008 in

bearing_clearance.rationale: Selected visual diametral bearing clearance, not calibrated thermal fit

bolt_radius.rationale: Illustrative smooth bolt; no thread size claim

bolt_clearance.rationale: Radial half of .0009 in midpoint diametral bolt clearance, B-2 PDF93

crown_top.rationale: Estimated crown position from wrist axis

skirt_bottom.rationale: Estimated skirt position from wrist axis

fitted_bore.rationale: Inherited source-backed 5.251-5.253 in cylinder bore midpoint; barrel not included

ring_clearance.rationale: Selected axial side clearance for static model

boss_length.rationale: Estimated integral pin boss axial width

damper_bushing_id.rationale: Table 6 PDF103: damper bushing ID .754-.756 in; selected midpoint

damper_bushing_wall.rationale: Selected wall/ID ratio 0.08; plausible section range 0.06-0.12, not a parts drawing; calculated as 0.08*damper_bushing_id

blade_bore_radius.rationale: Bare host radius from documented bushing ID plus estimated wall; final press-fit not established; calculated as (damper_bushing_id+2*damper_bushing_wall)/2

web_main_margin.rationale: Selected radial land margin 6% of main radius (working range 4-8%); calculated as 0.06*main_diameter/2

web_pin_margin.rationale: Selected radial land margin 10% of pin radius (working range 7-13%); calculated as 0.10*crankpin_diameter/2

middle_web_radius.rationale: Middle-cheek end radius follows pin and support land; calculated as crankpin_diameter/2+web_pin_margin

blade_edge_ligament.rationale: Selected minimum outer edge ligament one quarter of host diameter; not strength certification; calculated as 0.25*blade_bore_radius*2

blade_bore_offset.rationale: Two-hole pitch selected at 2.1 host diameters; each offset is half the pitch; calculated as 1.05*blade_bore_radius*2

blade_half_width.rationale: Preserve the selected outer edge ligament around both bores; calculated as blade_bore_offset+blade_bore_radius+blade_edge_ligament

blade_bore_row.rationale: Bore row outside the middle-web waist; selected 0.6 host diameter offset; calculated as middle_web_radius+0.60*blade_bore_radius*2

blade_root.rationale: Integral blade root overlaps the middle web; calculated as middle_web_radius-blade_edge_ligament

blade_tip.rationale: Tip follows bore row and remaining wall; calculated as blade_bore_row+blade_bore_radius+blade_edge_ligament

blade_width.rationale: Thinner centred blade, selected 60% of cheek width (working range 50-65%); fork fit pending; calculated as 0.60*cheek_width

cheek_taper_delta.rationale: Selected 15% reduction scale, working range 10-20%; slight inclined surfaces; calculated as 0.15*cheek_width

main_root_radius.rationale: Root radius limited to 75% of the radial support margin; calculated as 0.75*web_main_margin

pin_root_radius.rationale: Root radius limited to 60% of support margin and less than the current bearing wall; calculated as 0.60*web_pin_margin

bearing_edge_relief.rationale: 45-degree liner relief derived from root radius and side gap, plus 0.05 mm modelling margin; calculated as pin_root_radius-rod_side_clearance/2+0.05

pin_end_recess_radius.rationale: Selected visible recess diameter 32% of pin diameter (working range 25-40%); hidden drilling unverified; calculated as 0.16*crankpin_diameter

pin_end_recess_depth.rationale: Selected blind depth one quarter of cheek; preserve a closed web, no invented oil route; calculated as 0.25*cheek_width
